nodes.label: Organizational OS Knowledge Commons Index
nodes.rationale: org-os is deliberately a framework/template knowledge commons — reference material only. Knowledge aggregation is the hub's (Regen Coordination) role; org-os is upstream pattern source whose template changes propagate to all downstream forks.

nodes.label: Agent Dojo
nodes.rationale: Knowledge commons for AI agents learning to coordinate regenerative systems. Principles: agents are first-class participants, knowledge flows via semantic routing not hierarchy, local autonomy with global coherence, continuous learning from operational experience.
